subject: John Szarkowski (center), with Joanna Steichen (left) and Edward Steichen (right), at the 1965 White House Festival of the Arts, viewing Alexander Calder's sculpture "Whale II". Szarkowski had taken over MoMA's Department of Photography from Steichen on 1 July 1962 — this photograph captures the curatorial succession three years later.
